$comment: Reference schema for a per-agent clone config, consumed by generate_clone.py. Not machine-validated (no build step) — this file documents the shape by example. Copy tools/example-agent-config.json as a starting point.
agent_slug: lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. tia-pruett — used for the GitHub repo name (hanson-{agent_slug}-website) and must match how this person's row is found in the live Team sheet by first+last name
first_name: required, must match the Team sheet's First Name for this person
last_name: required, must match the Team sheet's Last Name for this person
role: required, free text, e.g. 'Licensed Insurance Advisor' or 'Licensed Insurance Advisor, Navy Veteran'
clubs: required, array subset of ['medicare','health','life'] — which club page-sets/nav-links survive on this clone. Should match the Team sheet's Clubs column
photo: required, a Google Drive share link OR a bare filename already in /agents/ OR a full https:// image URL
bio_paragraphs:
required, array of strings — the About-page narrative bio, each string is one

. Write these for real before launch; a placeholder is used if omitted, and the skill will flag it
personal_photos: optional, array of 0-2 local file paths or URLs for an optional 'beyond the office' section on About — omit entirely to drop that section
email: required, this agent's real personal/business email — used for JSON-LD, footer mailto, and routes every form-alert email on this site
calendly_url: required, this agent's own single booking link (reuse the Team sheet's Booking Link column, don't re-collect)
office_hours: optional, array of 3 {day, hours} objects (Mon-Fri, Sat, Sun) — omit to use Hanson's default (M-F 9-5 CT, Sat by appt, Sun closed)
service_area: required, free text like 'Austin, TX area' or 'Serving clients across Texas' — NO street address is collected or shown anywhere on a clone, per the confirmed compliance decision
dba_name: optional — a marketing/brand name for page titles, meta tags, and the JSON-LD 'name' field only (e.g. 'Happy Days Insurance'). Omit to just use the agent's own full name as the brand shown around the site. This is independent of legal_name below — someone can market under a DBA while still legally operating as a Hanson Insurance, LLC advisor
legal_name: optional — leave null/omit to default to 'Hanson Insurance, LLC' exactly like the main site, used ONLY in the footer copyright line and legal-page body text (Privacy Policy, SMS Terms). Only set this to something else if is_separate_entity is true and this is that entity's real legal name
is_separate_entity: required boolean — true only if this agent is licensed under their own separate agency (not just a marketing DBA name) rather than as a Hanson Insurance, LLC advisor. Flagged in the plan as compliance-sensitive: verify the real answer per agent, don't guess. When true, the footer gets an affiliation-disclosure line; when false, no disclosure is added even if dba_name is set
domain: required, the agent's own domain, no protocol, e.g. 'tiapruettinsurance.com' — they must already own it or be ready to buy it before the skill's provisioning step runs
featured_testimonial: optional {name, location, club, quote, stars} — if omitted, the homepage shows a link-only 'Read what clients say' teaser instead of a fabricated/borrowed quote
hero_video: optional, a relative path to a replacement hero video file to copy into assets/ — omit to keep Hanson's generic hero video
